name: gestao-solicitacoes-internas
description: Protótipo web para gestão de solicitações internas

scripts.contract:check: turbo run openapi:generate contract:generate && git diff --exit-code -- apps/api/openapi.json apps/web/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/api/openapi.json apps/web/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts)"
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && turbo run lint typecheck test build && pnpm contract:check && pnpm test:integration
